messages:
Renee (People Ops): Noticed an uptick in scorecard template mismatches for candidates imported this week — interviews show "Technical - Standard" rubric but hiring team requested "Technical - Deep Dive". @Ibrahim any idea?

Ibrahim (Recruiting Ops): Saw that too. It looks like the ATS tag->template mapping flipped when we rolled the new template version mapping on Tuesday. Old mapping used 'template_id' numeric, new one uses 'template_ref'.

Kelsey (Talent Systems): Confirmed. The webhook adapter falls back to numeric id when template_ref is missing; but a recent migration wrote template_ref="" for some legacy jobs, so we get fallback -> template 101 (Standard).

Marco (Hiring Manager): Uh oh — panel for ENG-7 uses Standard but interviewers expect deep questions. We have 3 interviews today. Can we switch quickly?

Ibrahim (Recruiting Ops): We can patch the scorecards for active interviews. Running a targeted patch for job ENG-7 and ENG-9. Dry-run first.

Kelsey (Talent Systems): Dry-run command:
```
python tools/patch_scorecards.py --dry-run --jobs ENG-7,ENG-9 --check=template_mismatch
```

Renee (People Ops): Please DM affected interviewers and hiring managers before you flip. Marco, do you want manual review before we change?

Marco (Hiring Manager): Manual review please for ENG-7, but ENG-9 go ahead.

Ibrahim (Recruiting Ops): Noted. Dry-run shows 6 scorecards to change. Proceeding to patch ENG-9 now, ENG-7 paused. ETA 12m.

ops-bot: Patch job queued: patch-scorecards-2026-03-22T11:24Z id=job_7721.

Kelsey (Talent Systems): Will submit PR to add a migration to backfill template_ref from template_lookup table and add unit test to assert mapping survives empty string. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/integrations/pulls/501

Renee (People Ops): Let's add a runbook step to verify template_ref population before any template-mapping deploy. Also log incident INC-2149 and add to postmortem.

Ibrahim (Recruiting Ops): Patch completed for ENG-9. Sent DM to interviewers. ENG-7 still pending manual review.

Marco (Hiring Manager): Thanks team. ENG-7 confirmed, you can patch now.

Ibrahim (Recruiting Ops): Patch applied to ENG-7 as well. All affected scorecards now show "Technical - Deep Dive". Closing loop and will attach a short summary to INC-2149.

Renee (People Ops): Great. After merge, please schedule a short incident retro and assign action items. :white_check_mark:
